title: Signal
caption: midnight broadcast. the signal is mint tonight. 🌙

shots.prompt: She slowly opens her eyes and takes one soft breath. A faint mint glow pulses once across her face from below. Camera: very slow push-in, 85mm feel, shallow depth of field. Photoreal, natural motion, stable face, subtle film grain.

Her gaze shifts to meet the lens, she blinks once naturally, and the corner of her mouth lifts slightly. Background bokeh lights shimmer softly. Camera: locked-off with barely perceptible handheld drift. Photoreal, natural blink timing, stable face.

She leans slightly toward the screen, eyes reading line by line. Mint screen light flickers gently across her cheek. Camera: slow lateral slide left to right, 50mm feel. Photoreal, natural motion, stable face and jacket.

She walks calmly toward camera at an unhurried pace, twin-tails swaying with each step. Neon reflections ripple on the wet pavement. Camera: slow backward tracking shot at walking speed, slight handheld feel. Photoreal, natural gait, stable face and clothing.
She rests her head lightly against the seat and watches outside. City lights streak past the window and slide across her face. Camera: locked-off, 50mm feel. Photoreal, natural motion, stable face.

A small, warm smile forms slowly, reaching her eyes, then softens. A soft mint rim light brightens slightly behind her. Camera: very slow push-in, 85mm feel. Photoreal, subtle micro-expression, stable face.

She slowly raises one hand toward the floating mint light, fingers relaxed. The light brightens gently and illuminates her palm. Camera: slow rack focus from her face to the light. Photoreal, natural hand motion, stable face.

She looks up slowly toward the sky beyond the glass. Rain droplets run down the window and catch neon light. Camera: locked-off, focus on the glass with her softly behind it. Photoreal, natural motion.

A light breeze lifts loose strands and gently moves her twin-tails while she holds a calm gaze. Distant city lights twinkle. Camera: slow arc right, under 20 degrees, 85mm feel. Photoreal, natural hair physics, stable face.

She speaks calmly to camera with natural small head movements, occasional blinks, and relaxed lip motion. The monitor glow behind her shifts gently. Camera: locked-off, eye level, 50mm feel. Photoreal, natural talking cadence, stable face.

She looks away thoughtfully, then back down, a slight tilt of the head. Lamp light warms slightly as the monitor glow dims. Camera: slow dolly-in, 50mm feel. Photoreal, subtle motion, stable face and jacket.
She gives a small, knowing nod to the lens. The mint light slowly fades to darkness around her. Camera: slow pull-out, 50mm feel. Photoreal, natural motion, stable face.
